question.text: The ICAI Guidance Note on Accounting for Derivatives Contract was revised in which year, and which regulatory framework superseded Accounting Standard (AS) 30 for entities following the Ind AS framework?

answer.text: ICAI Guidance Note revised in 2021; Ind AS 109 (based on IFRS 9) superseded AS 30 for Ind AS entities
ICAI Guidance Note revised in 2018; AS 30 continues to apply to all Indian entities
ICAI Guidance Note revised in 2021; Ind AS 32 superseded AS 30 for Ind AS entities
ICAI Guidance Note revised in 2019; IFRS 9 directly applies to all listed companies

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook identifies the ICAI Guidance Note on Accounting for Derivatives Contract as Revised 2021. It also states that AS 30 was withdrawn and replaced by Ind AS 109, which is based on IFRS 9 and is mandatory for companies that fall under the Ind AS roadmap. The Trap: Option B keeps AS 30 alive for all entities, contradicting the workbook. Option D claims IFRS 9 applies directly to all listed companies, but Indian listed companies follow Ind AS 109 (which is based on IFRS 9), not IFRS 9 itself. Note: Two anchor facts: the ICAI Guidance Note revision year is 2021, and for Ind AS entities the derivatives standard is Ind AS 109 (replacing AS 30 and based on IFRS 9).
